title: Rotating golden sample policy and timebox reconciliation for config-driven regressions
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: define and implement a rotating golden-sample policy and timebox reconciliation process so that config or model changes trigger meaningful, reproducible evals while limiting stale golden drift. Scope includes sampling stratification, TTL for golden examples, reviewer rotation cadence, automated reconciliation runs after config/model changes, and UI/admin controls for custodians to pin/escape samples. Out of scope: changes to model training data or external label sources.

Background: We've had two incidents where long-lived golden sets drifted from production distribution and caused false positives in regression alerts. The current manual re-sampling cadence and steward handoffs are inconsistent across teams. This ticket drives an engineering-first implementation of rotation policies, reconciliation automation, and audit-friendly telemetry so PMs and stewards can rely on the eval gates.

Non-goals: automatic label re-annotation pipeline, expensive large-scale re-sampling across all domains in a single run.

Key deliverables:
- policy engine and DB schema for sample lifecycle metadata (created_at, last_reviewed, steward, TTL, rotation_bucket)
- reconciliation job that runs after config/model change events and flags candidate replacements by stratified sampling
- admin endpoints and console controls to pin/unpin samples and override TTL for specific custodians
- telemetry: per-sample provenance (source commit/config hash), diff score, and reconciliation action logs
- migration that marks existing golden samples with default TTL and rotation buckets

Engineering trade-offs considered: keep per-sample metadata lightweight to avoid tokenization of large corpora, prefer incremental reconciliation to avoid expensive recomputation, and surface human-in-the-loop review before final swap to avoid accidental regressions.
activity_log: 2025-01-15 - Asha Patel: Created ticket and attached initial incident notes; flagged as P1 due to recent false-positive alerts.
2025-01-20 - Marco Li: Drafted DB schema and proposed fields; decided to store rotation_bucket as a short tag rather than a full fingerprint to speed queries.
2025-01-23 - Design review: UX mockup requested for admin pin/unpin flow; assigned to DES-201 for follow-up.
2025-01-28 - Marco Li: PoC reconciliation job implemented; uses stratified sampling by client and prompt-type; initial run on sample environment replaced 7% of set candidates.
2025-01-30 - Security: requested review of audit logs and signer flow; marked security_review_required=true.
2025-02-02 - Asha Patel: Added acceptance criteria and scheduled rollout plan; set due date 2025-02-14 for an initial gated rollout to staging clusters.
acceptance_criteria: Policy metadata persisted for every golden sample with fields: steward, created_at, last_reviewed, TTL_days, rotation_bucket, provenance_hash.
Reconciliation job runs automatically on config/model-change webhook and produces a candidate list with diff scores and provenance ties.
Admin console allows custodians to pin/unpin samples and approve candidate swaps; actions are logged to audit stream.
Migration applied and existing golden samples are backfilled with default TTL=180 days and rotation_bucket assigned deterministically.
Telemetry shows sample-level provenance and a reconciliation history view in Grafana; regression alert noise reduced on staging by >=40% in first run.
